messages.author: 5ccb721d28384a05
messages.subject: Issue with protein summarisation
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to use MSstatsTMT and I encounter an issue when trying to perform protein summarisation. I have 2 conditions (young and old), 3 biological replicates and two mixtures that have the same TMT labels (6plex). Each mixture has been fractionated 12 times. Based on this information I created an annotation file and ran the Rcode alongside my PSM file from proteome discoverer.

Whilst mixture 1 seems to run to completion, I get stuck on mixture 2 (stays on 1% completion), suggesting there is an issue here (see attached).I have also attached my annotation file in case there is any issue with my layout.

I have checked that the run names on the annotation file match the spectrum files on the PSM datasheet, so i'm not quite sure what the issue is here.

Any help would be much appreciated (this is my first time trying MSstats so I may have made an obvious error...)

Thanks

Sam

groupComparisonTMT(data = quant.msstats,
                                          contrast.matrix = "pairwise", 
                                          moderated = TRUE,

Many Thanks
